explication: KubeKey is a task-flow automation tool, with Kubernetes installation and lifecycle management as a major use case. A user can invoke a built-in cluster workflow from the CLI; task templates and playbooks are executed through the task engine, which uses modules, variables, and node connectors to perform work. The repository also provides Kubernetes controllers for cloud-native batch management and a Web API/UI. Several subsystem links below are documented rather than source-verified: unsampled implementation details are not inferred as call relationships.
